@welcomeTitle.description: The product name, shown as the welcome page title.

@welcomeSubtitle.description: One-line description under the welcome page title.

welcomeHintSidebar: Pick a tool from the left.

@welcomeHintSidebar.description: Welcome page card telling the user to choose a tool in the sidebar.

welcomeHintTitlebar: Switch the theme and language from the title bar.

@welcomeHintTitlebar.description: Welcome page card telling the user where the theme and language controls are.

@tools.description: Name of the sidebar navigation group in the main window.

@theme.description: Title and accessibility label of the title bar's theme control.

@language.description: Title and accessibility label of the title bar's language control.

@settingsTitle.description: Title of the settings dialog and of the title bar button that opens it.

@settingsTheme.description: Heading of the theme choices in the settings dialog.

@themeSystem.description: Theme choice that follows the system's light or dark appearance.

@themeLight.description: Theme choice that always uses the light appearance.

@themeDark.description: Theme choice that always uses the dark appearance.

@settingsLanguage.description: Heading of the language choices in the settings dialog.

@languageSystem.description: Language choice that follows the user's preferred languages.

@openSettings.description: Tooltip of the title bar button that opens the settings dialog.

@close.description: Button that closes the settings dialog.

launcherEmpty: The launcher is a skeleton for now.

@launcherEmpty.description: Placeholder shown in the launcher while it has no results.

@launcherOpenMain.description: Launcher button that shows the main window.

@launcherQuit.description: Launcher button that quits the application.
